description: Presidential Secretariat - Presidential Commission of Inquiry into Destructive Activities
reasoning: This gazette establishes a Commission of Inquiry to investigate specific incidents of vandalism and loss, outlining its mandate, powers, and reporting requirements. The content primarily deals with the creation of a legal investigative body, its terms of reference, and the legal authority under which it operates (Commissions of Inquiry Act). This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it concerns the establishment of a statutory commission and its legal framework for operation.
